hq_location.notes: The company privacy policy gives its headquarters address in Bucharest, Romania.

public_docs.notes: A public documentation portal exists with multiple product documentation areas and articles, including platform and knowledge-base documentation.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round identified is the September 2025 Series C, earlier than the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

founded_year.notes: The company says it was founded in 2018.

last_funding.notes: The reported Series C is $31 million. The September 17, 2025 article describes the $31 million round; the competing €26 million amount is approximately the same round.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 14, 2026, Druid announced platform capabilities including voice enhancements, agent interoperability, governance, and evaluation, within the six-month window.

pricing_page.notes: Pricing is customized and provided by quote; a public pricing page exists even though it does not publish prices.

employee_band.notes: Druid's Careers page states it has over 190 people worldwide; PitchBook reports 186 employees. These place it in the 101-200 band.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers page lists a Technical Consultant role and no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive title.

model_provider.notes: Druid has publicly described integrating ChatGPT through Microsoft Azure OpenAI services. This is a publicly stated integration, not necessarily the exclusive provider for its current product.

named_customers.notes: All three are named as customers in Druid's case studies.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers page lists a Technical Consultant position, not a role with AI, ML, or data science in its title.

compliance_certs.notes: Druid names SOC 2 and ISO 27001 as certifications; its security page also names GDPR as a certification claim. HIPAA is described as readiness/alignment rather than a certification, so it is not included.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Both systems are named on Druid's integrations page.

product_one_liner.value: Druid is an enterprise AI-agent platform that lets organizations build and deploy integrated agents to automate business processes and workflows.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The September 17, 2025 report says Joseph Kim was appointed CEO, within the 12-month window.
